clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Vol'jin advises Warchief Thrall while seeking a lasting home for his people. The Darkspear chieftain is a master shadow hunter.

Vol'jin leads the Darkspear after his father, Sen'jin, dies on their ancestral island. Sea witch-worshipping murlocs and human forces nearly destroy the isolated tribe, but Thrall's orcs intervene and forge a deep bond with the trolls. After fleeing the ruined islands, Vol'jin pledges his people to the New Horde and brings them across the Great Sea to Kalimdor.

The Darkspear settle in Durotar, but Zalazane's betrayal on the Echo Isles drives many refugees to the mainland at Sen'jin Village. Vol'jin spends much of his time in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar, giving Thrall his strategic counsel and shadow hunter skill. From the orcish capital, he watches over the young Horde and works to reclaim his people's lands.
